plot: During a midnight blackout in the pantry a sweet talking candle, Candlewick, offers to guide the bros to the light switch; Lolly adores him while Zeek notices his wax drips upward, the path ends in a cookie jar with their name tags because they are Halloween treats, and Lolly and Zeek stack everyone into a giant mirror shadow that scares Candlewick into his own jar, whose lid reads 'Treats for the Thing on the Roof' as a hundred flames wake in the garden.

script.title: The Friendly Candle Was Lying the Whole Time

beats.say: Lights out! LIGHTS OUT! Who switched off the pantry?!
Nobody move! I can't even see my own crust!
Shhh, little ones. No need to tremble. I'm Candlewick, and I'm here to help.
Oh, what a sweet glow! And such lovely manners!
The light switch is behind the cookie jar. Follow my flame. Single file, nice and close.
Hold on. Since when do candles talk? Or walk? Or know where switches are?
Zeek, don't be rude. He is literally the only light in here.
And so, one by one, the Dough Bros follow the little flame deeper into the dark shelves.
Careful. Fire that smiles is still fire.
Hee hee. Your rock friend is so gloomy. Lolly, dear, you walk right beside me.
He picked me! Did everyone hear that? He picked me first!
Pim, look at his wax. It's dripping UP. Wax does not drip up. Not ever.
M-m-maybe he's just a very optimistic candle?
And the shelf map says the switch is by the door. Nowhere near the cookie jar.
Then where exactly is he taking us?
Almost there! Just step inside this cozy jar. It's warm. It's safe. It smells like vanilla.
Inside a jar? Candlewick, why are there little name tags in here? Bup. Pim. Lolly...
Because you are the TREATS, sweetie! Halloween party, top shelf, midnight! Hee hee hee!
I knew it! I knew a candle was too polite! Okay. Fainting now.
Back to the door! Everyone, run!
Run where? I am the only light. Without me, you are lost in the dark forever.
He's right. I can't see the door. Every shelf looks exactly the same.
He called me sweetie. He made me a NAME TAG. Zeek. Do you still have your pocket mirror?
Always. Why?
Candles make shadows. Big ones. Let's show him the biggest shadow he has ever seen.
Light, mirror, angle... Lolly, that's brilliant! Everybody, climb onto my shoulders!
Bup climbs on Zeek. Lolly climbs on Bup. And Crispy drags sleeping Pim all the way to the top.
He's heavier when he's asleep.
Zeek tilts the mirror. On the wall behind Candlewick rises a giant shadow with five heads and one bandage.
WHOOO dares to light up MY pantry?!
A m-m-monster?! Nobody told me this pantry had a monster!
Huh? What's happening? Why am I so tall? AAAAAH!
It SCREAMED! I'm hiding! I'm hiding in the jar!
Candlewick dives head first into his own cookie jar. Bup slams the lid. Click.
Nice shadow, team. And nice scream, Pim.
That was a real scream. I would like that on the record.
Zeek, I'm sorry I called you rude. You were right about the drips.
Apology accepted. Science always notices the drips.
Before you celebrate. Read the lid.
On the jar lid, in curly icing letters: Treats for the Thing on the Roof.
Guys... look out the window. The garden.
Out in the dark garden, one by one, a hundred tiny candle flames are waking up.
